tactics.isoSummary: Show the isometric projection of the in-possession board
tactics.isoNote: Every dot above went through that pair of lines, from the same x/y metres the in-possession board uses — the projection is arithmetic over the board's own numbers, not a second set of coordinates kept in step by hand. Each marker carries the metres it was projected from beside the point it landed on, so the two can be compared without a screenshot. The lawn, the centre circle and the penalty arcs are the 2D frame's own Law 1 measurements, sampled in metres and projected point by point — a circle on the grass is an ellipse here, and computing that ellipse separately would be a second piece of maths to keep in step with the first.
tactics.isoNotNote: What this is not: a rendered scene. There is no camera, no depth buffer and no lighting, so nothing here can show you what a player would see — it is the plan view bent into a diamond, which is what makes it checkable.

video.metaDescription: Upload a clip, sample its frames, and read what the demo vision provider measured from its pixels.
video.lede: Upload a clip and the pipeline will read its container, sample frames at an even interval, and report where the non-pitch pixels moved. Every detection says which provider made it, and the provider says what it cannot see.
video.emptyNote: Nothing is analysed, and nothing is claimed, until a file arrives.

video.privacyChip: the clips are yours; the detections are a demo provider's pixel statistics
video.acceptedNote: Accepted: mp4, MOV and webm, checked from the file's own bytes — a renamed file of another kind is refused, not renamed back. Up to {max} per clip, {limit} clips per account ({used} used). Nothing is published: only this account can read a clip, its frames or its report.
video.ceilingNote: This account holds {limit} clips, which is the ceiling. Delete one to add another.
video.errNoId: The server accepted the file but returned no clip id.
video.errSend: The upload could not be sent: {cause}
video.reportMetaDescription: Frames sampled from an uploaded clip, and the pixel statistics a demo vision provider measured from them.
video.chipOriginTitleReport: Uploaded by this account; never published.

video.cannotPlay: This browser cannot play the file.

video.errComplete: The request could not be completed: {cause}
video.linkedNote: Linking a clip to your football identity or an M6 match lets the clip appear in those contexts and enables richer reports. Both links are optional and can be changed later.
video.shareNote: A share link is a revocable token (§17 pattern). It opens a public read of this clip with no session required and no owner identity disclosed. Revoking clears the token; the clip stays private.
video.framesEyebrow: The frames the measurements came from
video.framesNote: These are the same samples the provider read, converted to PNG for display only. Positions above are fractions of the frame width and height, so they line up with what you see here. Each ring marks one detection's (x, y) on the sample its timestamp falls on — the centre of the non-pitch pixels that provider measured, not a player or a ball — and hovering it prints the timestamp, the confidence and the sentence the measurement was called with.
video.reportProvenanceChip: the clip is yours; the detections are a demo provider's measurements of it
video.sharedMetaDescription: The record a FOOTBALL OS upload leaves behind, handed over by a revocable link — no account required.

video.sharedProvenanceChip: shared via revocable link; no owner identity is disclosed here

home.metaTitle: Watch. Understand. Train. Play. Manage. Become.
home.metaDescription: FOOTBALL OS is a football operating system for fans, players and coaches. Today the AI player-coach vertical slice works end to end; the live football-world modules are still being built.
home.heroLede: One system for the whole football journey — follow the game, learn it, train against an explainable AI coach, and watch a player profile grow from real sessions.
home.moduleLiveBody: Live scores are not shown because no match feed is licensed yet. This module ships with M3 Football World.
home.moduleWorldBodyOn: Football World ships with M3 (module status: {status}). No fixtures, tables or transfers are displayed because no data source is connected.
home.moduleWorldBodyOff: Football World ships with M3. No fixtures or transfers are shown — the capabilities endpoint is currently unreachable.
home.moduleNewsBody: No news headlines are rendered because no provider is licensed. When it lands, every item will carry its source.
home.notBuiltHint: This module is on the roadmap and not implemented yet.
home.signInTitle: Sign in to see your football
home.signInBody: Your OVR, streak and completed sessions appear here once you have an account and a player profile.
home.noPlayerBody: Create your football identity to start earning XP and growing attributes.
home.whatWorksLede: The M1 player & AI-coach vertical slice runs end to end. Everything below uses real requests against the backend — nothing here is faked.
home.featureTrainingBody: A library of drills with setup, instructions, coaching points, common mistakes and progressions.
home.featureCoachBody: Ask for a recommendation and get the chosen drill plus the reasons behind it — every answer is labelled demo vs live.
home.featureProgressBody: Completing sessions awards XP and nudges the attributes a drill targets, so your OVR is earned, not invented.
home.featureDataBody: Export your sessions and attributes, or delete everything you have stored, straight from settings.
home.policySyntheticBody: Player profiles, attributes and content in this build are synthetic demo data. They are not real athletes and are labelled as demo wherever they appear.
home.policyLicensedBody: No club, league, player imagery or broadcast assets are used or claimed. Anything that would need a licence simply is not shown yet.
